title: 第五章 奔雷九响【为了冲榜】
slug: 武神空间全本免费-武神空间最新章节列表
content_zh:
叶希文也不浪费时间，立刻控制着特殊空间中的神念开始推演奔雷手的精髓，顿时无数的信息顿时涌上了心头！
叶希文顿时一喜，看来，自己所猜测的没有错，非但内功能够演练，就连武技也不例外。
解构出奔雷手精髓，一遍一遍的打着，恍惚之间，犹如行云流水，收发随心。
叶希文开始演练起了奔雷手，奔雷手有雷厉风行，电闪雷鸣，鬼工雷斧，平地风雷四招，虽然招数不多，但是却是易学难精，很难练到极致。
“轰隆隆！”
叶希文一掌一掌拍出，很快就将整个奔雷手演练了一遍。
叶希文打着奔雷手一遍又一遍，陡然发现，对于奔雷手的感悟居然不断的涌上心头，如果说以前的感悟速度是小溪流的速度的话，那么现在叶希文的感悟速度，绝对是长江黄河，奔涌不息。
“轰隆！”
“轰隆！”
“轰隆！”
也不知道过去了多久，叶希文每发出一掌，隐隐约约竟然带出了几分雷鸣的声音，这分明已经是将奔雷手练到一定的地步才会出现的异象。
“雷厉风行！”叶希文轻喝一声，右手势若闪电一般探出，带出几声闷声一掌拍在一块坚硬的青石板上，顿时那块青石板被生生拍散，甚至其中大半更是直接化为粉末。
叶希文看了看自己的双手，有些不可思议的说道：“没想到不过是推演出了奔雷手精髓的一小部分，居然能打出两响，继续推演下去，说不定真的能在一个月内打出九响也很难说！”
要知道，这一套奔雷手，易学难精，但是这才短短时间内，靠着特殊空间的领悟，居然就接连突破，接连突破到了两响的地步。
奔雷手易学难精，一般能打出两响的都是修炼了一年以上的老手了，至于说要打出九响，很多人练了一辈子都达不到。
叶希文的身上传来了噼里啪啦的脆响声，叶希文身上一点点的黑色杂质随着汗水，一点一点的排出了身体，他的肉身都更加的纯粹了。
叶希文发现，随着奔雷手突破到了两响，自己的力量居然增长了。
叶希文顿时大喜，一拳打出，空气都被打的噼里啪啦爆响。
他的力量居然从原本的五百七十斤，一举突破到了六百三十斤，足足增长了六十斤，没想到这奔雷九手，每一响之间居然差这么多。
后天第四重是第一个分水岭，达到后天四重之后，力量达到五百斤，也就是一头猛虎之力，威猛之极。

而到了后天五重，力量更是飙升，达到了一千斤，两虎之力。
没想到将奔雷手练到第二响之后，力量能增加这么多。
一般人修炼起来也没有这么大的效果，因为他们都是一层一层突破的，但是叶希文不一样，他是一夜之间突破的，因此这力量增长的特别明显。
——————
“轰隆隆！”
天微微亮，旭日初升，叶希文所在的小院子里，叶希文正在不知道疲倦的不断演练着奔雷手，已经演练了一整夜的奔雷手了。
叶希文掌法掌法浑圆连绵，如水流般流畅无阻，由于有着特殊空间的演练，所以叶希文修炼起掌法来，犹如行云流水，信手拈来，仿佛是极为熟稔一般。
叶希文一丝不苟的一遍一遍的打着奔雷手，整个院子里都是轰隆隆的犹如雷鸣一般的声音，又一趟奔雷手打下来，叶希文全身都湿透了，酣畅淋漓，全身都有蒸汽升腾而起，几乎犹如是云雾缭绕一般。
叶希文每打一遍奔雷手，真气就在全身走一遍，叶希文的气血就更加的旺盛，力量都会增强不少。
一开始，效果极为明显，几乎叶希文每打一遍奔雷手，身上的力量都会增加一斤，到后来效果越来越弱，但是每打十遍奔雷手，几乎都会增加一斤的力量。
三天下来，叶希文的力量再度增加了两百四十斤，达到了八百七十斤！
“电闪雷鸣！”叶希文大吼一声，居然一掌打出了四声雷暴声，也就是说，三天下来，他居然又多练出两响。
巨大的雷暴声和在特殊空间时候并无二致。

content_en:
Ye Xiwen didn't waste any time, and immediately controlled the spiritual thoughts in the special space and began to deduce the essence of the Thunder Hand, and countless information suddenly came to his mind!
Ye Xiwen was immediately overjoyed. It seemed that what he had guessed was correct. Not only could he practice his internal skills, but he could also practice martial arts.
Deconstruct the essence of Ben Lei Shou and hit it over and over again. In a trance, it is like flowing clouds and flowing water, sending and receiving at will.
Ye Xiwen began to practice the Thunder Hand. The Thunder Hand has four moves: thunder and lightning, lightning, thunder axe, and flat ground wind and thunder. Although there are not many moves, they are easy to learn and difficult to master, and difficult to practice to the extreme.
"Boom!"
Ye Xiwen clapped his hands one after another and quickly practiced the entire Thunder Hand.
Ye Xiwen hit the Thunder Hand over and over again, and suddenly found that the understanding of the Thunder Hand was constantly flooding into his heart. If the speed of understanding before was the speed of a small stream, then Ye Xiwen's speed of understanding now is definitely the endless flow of the Yangtze and Yellow Rivers.
"Boom!"
"Boom!"
"Boom!"
I don't know how much time has passed, but every time Ye Xiwen sends out a palm, there is a faint sound of thunder. This is obviously a phenomenon that can only occur after practicing the thunder hand to a certain level.
"Thunder and resolute!" Ye Xiwen shouted softly, stretched out his right hand like lightning, and slapped a hard bluestone with his palm with a few muffled sounds. The bluestone was immediately scattered, and most of it was turned into powder.
Ye Xiwen looked at his hands and said with some disbelief: "I didn't expect that I could actually hit two rings after deducing only a small part of the essence of the Thunder Hand. If I continue to deduce it, I might actually be able to hit nine rings in a month. It's hard to say!"
You know, this set of Thunder Runners is easy to learn but difficult to master, but in just a short period of time, relying on the understanding of the special space, I actually made breakthroughs one after another, reaching the point of two consecutive breakthroughs.
Thunder running is easy to learn but difficult to master. Generally, those who can make two rings are veterans who have been practicing for more than a year. As for making nine rings, many people can't achieve it after practicing for a lifetime.
There was a crackling sound from Ye Xiwen's body. The black impurities on Ye Xiwen's body were discharged bit by bit with sweat, and his body became purer.
Ye Xiwen found that as the thunder hand broke through to two rings, his strength actually increased.
Ye Xiwen was immediately overjoyed and punched out, making the air crackle and pop.
His strength actually broke through from the original 570 kilograms to 630 kilograms in one fell swoop, a full increase of 60 kilograms. He didn't expect that the difference between each sound of the Nine Thunder Hands would be so big.
The fourth acquired level is the first watershed. After reaching the acquired fourth level, the strength reaches 500 kilograms, which is the strength of a tiger, extremely powerful.
At the fifth level of the day after tomorrow, the strength soared even more, reaching a thousand kilograms, the strength of two tigers.
I didn't expect that after practicing the thunder hand to the second ring, the strength can increase so much.
Most people's cultivation does not have such a great effect, because they all break through layer by layer, but Ye Xiwen is different. He broke through overnight, so the increase in power is particularly obvious.
——————
"Boom!"
The sky was slightly brighter and the sun was rising. In the small courtyard where Ye Xiwen was, Ye Xiwen was practicing Thunderbolt Hands without knowing he was tired. He had been practicing Thunderbolt Hands all night.
Ye Xiwen's palm technique is round and continuous, as smooth as water flow. Due to the special space for practice, Ye Xiwen practices the palm technique like clouds and flowing water, and he can pick it up easily, as if he is extremely familiar with it.
Ye Xiwen hit the thunder hand meticulously over and over again. There was a rumbling sound like thunder in the whole yard. Another thunder hand hit. Ye Xiwen's whole body was soaked, dripping with pleasure, and steam rose from his body.It rises into the sky, almost as if it is surrounded by clouds and mist.
Every time Ye Xiwen hits the thunder hand, the true energy moves through the whole body. Ye Xiwen's energy and blood become more vigorous and his strength increases a lot.
In the beginning, the effect was extremely obvious. Almost every time Ye Xiwen hit the Thunder Hand, his strength would increase by one kilogram. Later, the effect became weaker and weaker, but every time he hit the Thunder Hand ten times, his strength would increase by almost one kilogram.
After three days, Ye Xiwen's strength increased by another 240 kilograms, reaching 870 kilograms!
"Lightning and thunder!" Ye Xiwen roared, and actually made four thunderstorm sounds with one palm. In other words, in three days, he actually made two more thunder sounds.
The sound of a huge thunderstorm is no different from that in a special space.
